---
title: "LLM Assistant"
---

LLM-powered interactive pipeline builder that guides you through
configuring a SpectraWeaveR analysis pipeline via natural language
conversation. Requires the [ellmer](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/) package
(optional dependency).

## `sw_assistant` {#sw_assistant}

Launch the interactive LLM pipeline builder.

### Usage

```r
sw_assistant(
  provider = "openai",
  model = NULL,
  interactive = TRUE,
  privacy_notice = TRUE,
  ...
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `provider` | LLM provider: `"openai"` (default), `"anthropic"`, `"google"`, `"ollama"`. |
| `model` | Optional model name. If `NULL`, the provider default is used. |
| `interactive` | If `TRUE` (default), launches a live console. If `FALSE`, returns the `Chat` object. |
| `privacy_notice` | If `TRUE` (default), shows a privacy notice before starting. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to the ellmer chat constructor. |

### Details

The assistant:

1. Asks about your experiment (cytometer, samples, batches)
2. Inspects your FCS files and metadata using registered tools
3. Helps select markers and configure pipeline parameters
4. Generates runnable R code using `run_pipeline()` or `sw_pipeline()`

**Privacy**: File paths, directory listings, and column names are sent to the
LLM provider. No cell expression data is transmitted. Use `provider = "ollama"`
for fully local operation.

### Examples

```r
# Interactive session with OpenAI
sw_assistant()

# Use Anthropic Claude
sw_assistant(provider = "anthropic")

# Local model via Ollama
sw_assistant(provider = "ollama", model = "llama3")

# Get the Chat object for programmatic use
chat <- sw_assistant(interactive = FALSE)
chat$chat("I have 20 Aurora FCS files in /data/fcs/")
```

## `sw_assistant_configure` {#sw_assistant_configure}

Create a configured chat object without starting an interactive session.

### Usage

```r
sw_assistant_configure(provider = "openai", model = NULL, ...)
```

### Arguments

Same as `sw_assistant()`, except there is no `interactive` or
`privacy_notice` argument.

### Value

An ellmer `Chat` object with SpectraWeaveR tools registered.

## `sw_generate_pipeline_code` {#sw_generate_pipeline_code}

Generate runnable R code from a pipeline configuration.

### Usage

```r
sw_generate_pipeline_code(
  config,
  style = c("run_pipeline", "composable"),
  output = c("console", "string", "file"),
  path = NULL
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `config` | Named list with pipeline configuration (see below). |
| `style` | `"run_pipeline"` (default) or `"composable"` for `sw_pipeline()` style. |
| `output` | `"console"` (print), `"string"` (return), or `"file"` (write to `path`). |
| `path` | File path when `output = "file"`. |

### Config Fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| `fcs_dir` | Yes | Path to FCS files directory. |
| `sample_meta_path` | Yes | Path to sample metadata CSV/XLSX. |
| `markers` | Yes | Character vector of marker names. |
| `lineage_markers` | Yes | Character vector of lineage markers for clustering. |
| `batch_col` | No | Batch column name (default: `"batch"`). |
| `sample_col` | No | Sample ID column name (default: `"sample"`). |
| `file_col` | No | FCS filename column name (default: `"file"`). |
| `condition_col` | No | Condition column name. |
| `cofactor` | No | Arcsinh cofactor (default: 6000). |
| `n_metaclusters` | No | Number of metaclusters (default: 20). |
| `gating_template` | No | Path to gating template CSV or `NULL`. |
| `output_dir` | No | Output directory (default: `"SpectraWeaveR_output"`). |
| `seed` | No | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `unmix_from_raw` | No | Whether to unmix from raw data (default: `FALSE`). |
| `cytometer` | No | Cytometer type (for unmixing). |
| `control_dir` | No | Controls directory (for unmixing). |
| `unstained_fcs` | No | Unstained FCS path (for unmixing). |

### Examples

```r
config <- list(
  fcs_dir = "/data/fcs",
  sample_meta_path = "/data/metadata.csv",
  markers = c("CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "CD19"),
  lineage_markers = c("CD3", "CD4", "CD8"),
  cofactor = 6000,
  n_metaclusters = 20,
  output_dir = "results",
  seed = 42
)

# Print to console
sw_generate_pipeline_code(config)

# Get as string
code <- sw_generate_pipeline_code(config, output = "string")

# Composable style
sw_generate_pipeline_code(config, style = "composable")

# Save to file
sw_generate_pipeline_code(config, output = "file", path = "my_pipeline.R")
```

## `sw_quick_pipeline` {#sw_quick_pipeline}

Generate pipeline code from a natural language description (one-shot).

### Usage

```r
sw_quick_pipeline(description, provider = "openai", model = NULL, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `description` | Character string describing your experiment and analysis goals. |
| `provider` | LLM provider (default: `"openai"`). |
| `model` | Optional model name. |
| `...` | Additional arguments for the chat constructor. |

### Examples

```r
code <- sw_quick_pipeline(
  description = "I have 20 Aurora 5L FCS files in /data/fcs/,
    metadata in /data/meta.csv with columns filename, patient_id,
    batch_number, treatment. Markers: CD3, CD4, CD8, CD19, CD56.
    Cluster on CD3, CD4, CD8.",
  provider = "openai"
)
cat(code)
```

## `sw_pipeline_config_type` {#sw_pipeline_config_type}

Returns an ellmer type schema for structured extraction of pipeline
configuration from an LLM conversation.

### Usage

```r
sw_pipeline_config_type()
```

### Value

An ellmer `TypeObject` defining the pipeline configuration schema. Use
with `chat$chat_structured()` to extract validated configuration from
conversation context.

### Examples

```r
config_type <- sw_pipeline_config_type()
chat <- sw_assistant(interactive = FALSE)
config <- chat$chat_structured(
  "Extract the pipeline configuration from our conversation.",
  type = config_type
)
sw_generate_pipeline_code(config)
```

---

## Registered Tools

The assistant has access to the following tools that it can invoke during
conversation:

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `list_fcs_files` | List FCS files in a directory. |
| `list_directory` | List files and subdirectories at a path. |
| `read_fcs_header` | Read channel/marker names from an FCS file header. |
| `read_csv_columns` | Preview columns and rows of a CSV file. |
| `read_xlsx_columns` | Preview columns and rows of an XLSX file. |
| `validate_sample_meta` | Validate metadata against FCS files. |
| `detect_channels` | Classify FCS channels into scatter/time/fluorochrome. |
| `check_batch_balance` | Summarise sample distribution across batches. |
| `validate_markers` | Check that markers exist in FCS data. |
